# Examples

These examples name skills explicitly so their full procedure is loaded.

## Adopt the kit in an existing repository

```text
Use $project-onboarding. Inventory this repository without changing it, list
the missing agreement inputs, and stop before Phase 0β if the agreement merge
is not present. Do not infer project commands.
```

## Collect an external design without leaking it

```text
Use $context-collection for the payment-redesign topic. Keep the original in
its governed source, add only stable references and the minimum extracted
facts, classify sensitivity, and list contradictions without resolving them.
```

## Activate the builtin connector

```bash
.github/scripts/setup-sources.sh --source builtin --dry-run
.github/scripts/setup-sources.sh --source builtin --apply
```

The second command writes only the local registry after remote preflight. It
does not open or merge the activation PR.

## Plan a parallel wave

```text
Use $plan-management to decompose Epic #42 just in time. Make Task ownership
paths disjoint, add blocked-by edges where paths overlap, and show the
mechanically actionable frontier. Do not dispatch more work than the reviewer
can absorb.
```

## Audit a Task before completion

```text
Use $verification and the reviewer agent. Trace every acceptance criterion
through the work-order body, authoritative plan comment, diff, fresh evidence,
and required checks. Report findings first; do not repair the implementation.
```

## Design an automation safely

```text
Use $codex-automation to compare a repository hook, MCP connector, app
automation, and GitHub Action for this recurring check. Recommend the smallest
supported mechanism, identify permissions and secrets, and do not enable or
schedule anything until I approve the exact mutation.
```

## Resume after a crash

```text
Use $session-orchestration to resume Task #57. Re-read the repository, Issue
timeline, worktree, branch, PR, and checks; identify orphaned ownership and the
latest authoritative plan; prepare a Resume comment before continuing.
```
